fields.Name: T203 - System Diagnostics Engine Registry Refresh
fields.Description: Exercises the engine-card grid rendering plus the refreshAllEngines() action that re-queries BaseEngineRegistry — a live in-memory registry read/refresh path, not a generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the Admin application, open 'Monitoring', and select System Diagnostics. On the Engine Registry section you should see a grid of engine cards each showing memory and item-count stats (or a clear empty-state if none are loaded). Click the 'Refresh All Engines' button and confirm it responds — a spinning refresh indicator appears and the engine cards remain rendered afterward. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the refresh action run and the engine cards render is success; you do NOT need to inspect specific engine values.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Engine Registry section shows engine cards with Memory and Items stats, OR a valid 'No engines registered yet' empty-state
Clicking 'Refresh All Engines' triggers a visible response (spinning icon and/or the button disabling briefly)
After the refresh completes the engine card grid (or empty-state) is still rendered intact
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
